stepTitle: Is there a unique solution to the optimal parameters $$\theta$$ that minimizes MSE for the model $$\hat{y$$} $$=$$ $$\operatorname{f_{\theta}}\left(x\right)$$ $$=$$ $$\theta_0$$ + $$\theta_1$$ $$x_1$$ + \theta_2(8x_1 $$-$$ $$1)$$ + \theta_3(3x_2 + $$5)$$?
stepBody: We have a dataset $$\{(x_{i1}, x_{i2}, y_i)\}_{i=1}**n$$, $$where$$ $$features$$ $$1$$ $$and$$ $$2$$ $$are$$ $$x_{i1}$$, $$x_{i2}$$ and the target is $$y_i$$.
